newsitem.title: ANGOLA: Angolan Air Force helicopter missing - report.
newsitem.headline: Angolan Air Force helicopter missing - report.

text.p: An Angolan Air Force helicopter carrying civilians has been reported missing over Bengo province while en route to Luanda, the national news agency Angop said on Thursday.
It said the MI-8 helicopter had lost contact with Luanda control tower on Wednesday afternoon while flying over Ambriz in northern Bengo province.
An air force plane had been sent to the area to search for the helicopter, Angop added.
The national agency did not say if the helicopter had crashed, or how many people were on board. The report could not be independently confirmed.
